note: The drive-in base camp at the south end of Umbagog Lake, beside a swimming beach and a marina with canoe and kayak rentals. Most sites are short; 15 take a 23-ft rig. The lake's boat-in remote sites and cabins are not part of this entry. --Claude
summary: Park page + 2026 base map + schedule + RA per-site read of all 68 units: 32 drive-in base sites, water + electric (15/30, 50 A at 001 and 042), no sewer, showers/laundry/dump/store; 15 RV sites take 23 ft+ (max 40, all back-in); $45 checked July and September 2027; season 5/15-10/11 (2026); 3 sites non-reservable. Lakefront kept on sites 3, 4 and 10 at the head of the beach.
flags: Waterfront lakefront kept (not --AWH). RA tags 1A-1D, 003, 004, 010, 041 and 042 'Lakefront'. On Esri imagery sites 3, 4 and 10 sit in the open grass play area at the head of the swimming beach, 010 (44.70419,-71.05123) ~35 m and 003 (44.70439,-71.05100) ~20-30 m from the waterline over open grass and sand, gentle beach - passes the kayak test. 1A-1D line the road on a wooded point east of the beach (canopy to the water: a view), and 041/042 sit in forest ~50 m from the marina cove (view). RA's GIS points run ~20-30 m north of the real pads (1C/1D plot in the lake), so site-level distances are approximate. All three named sites are sold nightly on RA ($45).
Rig length: 15 of the 28 RA drive-in units take 23 ft+ (1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, 001, 002, 003, 004, 007, 010, 027, 028, 033, 042, 043); the rest are 20 ft or less.
Season: derived 05-22/10-14 -> 05-15/10-11 (2026). The schedule's 10/18 last reservable date and the park page's 'Closed 10/11' disagree; the closure date is used.
Pin 44.70301,-71.05031 sits on the visitor-centre lot ~120 m SE of the site centre (44.7038,-71.0513); no move.
Park page links an 'Umbagog Lake Campground Redevelopment Project' but the linked projects pages list nothing for Umbagog; no closure announced.
Split candidate: the 33 boat-in remote sites and 4 remote cabins (R01-R05 at ~44.72-44.73,-71.07; cabins at ~44.778,-71.059) are boat-access only - out of scope, not a split.
